Ziele

PHBern slide types distinguish instructional intent.

Bundled illustrations support consistent visual language.

title: PHBern Reveal.js

Multimedia Learning
Multimedia learning is not the accumulation of media. Text, image, and explanation should support the learner’s selection, organization, and integration of information (Mayer 2021).
